fullContentHtml:
Download App Get Started for Free

The Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC) has officially announced the JPSC Civil Services Pre Result 2026 for the Jharkhand Combined Civil Services Preliminary Competitive Examination 2025 (Advertisement No. 01/2026). The JPSC Pre result is published on the basis of order dated 30 June 2026 passed by Hon’ble High Court of Jharkhand in W.P.(S) No. 1276/2026. Online applications are invited from the candidates who qualified in the Preliminary Examination for the JPSC Civil Services Mains Examination from 03 July 2026. Commission has also informed the candidates that detailed instructions regarding document upload and submission of hard copies will be issued separately.

JPSC Previous Year Papers PDF: Click to Download

JPSC Pre Result 2026 Out

Jharkhand Public Service Commission has released JPSC Civil Services Preliminary Result 2026 for Combined Civil Services Examination 2025. The result has been declared as per the directives of the Hon’ble Jharkhand High Court. Candidates can download the merit list pdf from the official website and check their qualifying status.

JPSC Syllabus PDF: Click to Download

JPSC Civil Services Prelims Result 2026 Highlights

The Commission has released the revised result of the Preliminary Examination in an official press release. Candidates can refer the table below for important dates and latest updates on Prelims Result for JPSC Exam.

Particulars Details
Conducting Authority Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC)
Examination Jharkhand Combined Civil Services Preliminary Examination 2025
Advertisement No. 01/2026
Preliminary Exam Date 19 April 2026
Result Release Date 2 July 2026
Result Status Released
Mains Application Starts 3 July 2026
Official Website www.jpsc.gov.in

JPSC Civil Services Pre Result 2026 PDF

The JPSC Pre Result PDF will have the roll numbers of the qualified candidates for the Main Examination. Candidates are advised to check their roll number in the result PDF and download a copy for future reference.

Download JPSC Pre Result 2026 PDF

What Details Are Mentioned in the JPSC Pre Result PDF?

Candidates should check all the important details mentioned in the JPSC Civil Services Result PDF after downloading it to avoid any confusion in the next stage of the recruitment process.

  • Roll Number of Qualified Candidate
  • Examination Name
  • Advertisement Number
  • Result Declaration Date
  • Important Instructions
  • Official Signature/Authority

JPSC Salary and Job Profile: Click to Check

What After JPSC Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify in the Preliminary Examination are eligible to appear in the next stage of the selection process. The online application process for Main (Written) Examination will commence from July 3, 2026 and detailed instructions for uploading documents and submission of hard copy will be issued separately as per the official notification.

JPSC Mains Application Date 2026

JPSC Pre Result qualified candidates can apply for main examination by filling online application form through official website of JPSC from 3rd July 2026. All the necessary educational and category certificates should be kept ready by the applicants before applying.

14th JPSC Mains Exam Date 2026

Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC) has declared 14th JPSC Mains Exam Date 2026 for Jharkhand Combined Civil Services Examination (Advertisement No. 01/2026). The 14th JPSC Main Examination will be conducted on 18, 19 and 20 July, 2026. The candidates who qualified in the Preliminary Examination have to fill online application process from 3 July to 9 July 2026 (till 5:00 PM). The hard copy of the application form along with the necessary documents should reach the Commission on or before 14 July 2026 (5:00 PM).

What is the JPSC Selection Process?

The recruitment process for JPSC Civil Services has four phases. Candidates have to qualify at each stage to get final selection for various administrative services in the State of Jharkhand.

Stage Selection Process
Stage 1 Preliminary Examination
Stage 2 Main Written Examination
Stage 3 Interview/Personality Test
Stage 4 Document Verification

JPSC Pre Cut Off Marks PDF: Click to Download

How to Correct Errors in JPSC Pre Result 2026?

To correct errors in JPSC civil services pre result 2026, the commission reserves the right to make necessary corrections if any clerical, typographical or printing error is noticed in the published result. Any genuine discrepancy should be reported by the candidates immediately through the official channel.

JPSC Pre Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Has the JPSC Civil Services Pre Result 2026 been declared?

Ans: Yes, JPSC Civil Services Preliminary Result 2026 was declared on 2nd July 2026.

Q2. What is the reason for the declaration of JPSC Pre Result through press notice?

Ans: The result has been published as per the order of Hon’ble Jharkhand High Court Dated 30.06.2026.

Q3. When was the Preliminary Examination conducted by JPSC?

Ans: On 19 April 2026 the Preliminary Examination was conducted.

Q4. What is the starting date for applying for the JPSC Civil Services Mains Examination?

Ans: The Main Examination Apply Online active from 3rd July 2026.

Q5. What should the candidates do after clearing the JPSC Preliminary Exam?

Ans: Candidates should download the result, submit the application for Main Examination and follow the instructions of the Commission for uploading documents and submission of hard copy.
